abstract.p: This paper presents our approach to the MGT Detection Task 1, which focuses on detecting AI-generated content. The objective of this task is to classify texts as either machine-generated or human-written. We participated in Subtask A, which concentrates on English-only texts. We utilized the RoBERTa model for semantic feature extraction and the LLaMA3 model for probabilistic feature analysis. By integrating these features, we aimed to enhance the system's classification accuracy. Our approach achieved strong results, with an F1 score of 0.7713 on Subtask A, ranking ninth among 36 teams. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of our feature integration strategy.
